title: Expectation over a split sign cube
statement: Let $k,m$ be nonnegative integers and let $g:\\{-1,1\\}^m\\to\\mathbb R$. For a uniformly random sign vector $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^{k+m}$, take its last $m$ coordinates, denoted $y$. Then $\\mathbb E[g(y)]=\\mathbb E_{y\\in\\{-1,1\\}^m}[g(y)]$, where the expectation on the right is uniform.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function $g$ on the $m$-dimensional sign cube
